prompt: Generate a panoramic editorial photograph for a website banner in an 8:3 (2880 × 1080) target frame. Allow generous expendable space above, below and at both sides because the output will be cropped to a very wide 8:3 photo, then used in responsive cover frames. Authentic editorial photography with warm tones and natural skin. No text, logos, watermarks, borders, multiple panels or overlays.
